VO.note: the insect's own interior monologue, not a person in a room
VO.from: "I remember being a butterfly. I remember the roof as a brightness I could not enter."
VO.dir: Interior monologue, close and unplaced — no room around it. Past tense recalled without nostalgia. Very slow. No performance of wonder; it is stating what it did.

MARA.note: a researcher deciding in real time whether to delete her own evidence
MARA.from: "both hands inside the sleeves, although there was nothing left for her hands to do" · "a woman held her breath"
MARA.dir: Level, precise, under-pitched. She answers questions with the fewest words that are true. Never raises. Where she is certain she gets shorter, not louder. Audible held breath before the sentences that cost her something.

NIKO.note: treats procedural distinctions as moral ones
NIKO.from: "He still treated procedural distinctions as if they were moral ones."
NIKO.dir: Quick, clean, faintly indignant — the tone of someone quoting a rule he believes in. Rising on the correction. He is younger than her and it shows in how fast he answers.

IONA.note: expressions arrive before the features can contain them
IONA.from: "the expressions moving beneath it were quick, almost juvenile, arriving before the features could contain them"
IONA.dir: Old, dry, unhurried, and faintly amused at being doubted. She answers a question with a different question's answer. Aphoristic — each line lands like something she has said before and expects not to be believed.

IONA (V.O.).note: the voicemail — through a phone, over breathing like water on stone
IONA (V.O.).from: "a larger rhythm, rough and receding, like water dragged over stone"
IONA (V.O.).dir: The same woman, through a telephone. Slower. Breath audible before and after each clause. Flat, certain, and not addressed to anyone who can reply.

ELISE (V.O.).note: not the voice from the illness — the voice from childhood
ELISE (V.O.).from: "impatient and amused, calling from the front seat while Mara knelt backward in the car"
ELISE (V.O.).dir: Warm, impatient, amused. Calling forward over road noise to a child in the back. Absolutely ordinary — this is a mother telling a kid to face front, and it must not sound supernatural.

THE GIRL.note: quiet, embarrassed, sorry to require attention
THE GIRL.from: "The sound was quiet, embarrassed, as if the child had been waiting a long time and was sorry to require attention."
THE GIRL.dir: Eight years old. Small, level, apologetic. Not frightened and not sing-song. She is delivering information she assumes is unwelcome.

IONA (O.S.).note: the same woman, speaking from the dark at the pool's edge
IONA (O.S.).from: "Iona's voice came from the dark. 'You see why it survives.'"
IONA (O.S.).dir: Iona exactly, but unplaced — she is behind the listener, in a room with the lights out. No projection, no raise. Closer than a room should allow.

PROJECTED MARA.note: Mara's own voice, off a film that has no soundtrack
PROJECTED MARA.from: "Her lips moved. This time there was sound."
PROJECTED MARA.dir: Mara exactly, but recorded — thinner, band-limited, one room further away. She is saying the film's first line back to her own face.

sound.cue: the pairing that made the memory
sound.from: the referent: a scent paired with a mild shock at the caterpillar stage — the levels tested on the researcher's own arm first
sound.note: THE CAUSE OF EVERYTHING IN THIS FILM, and it is never seen. A soft scent-hiss, a gap, then a tick. It plays under the scenes that are ABOUT the memory rather than the scenes that contain it.

sound.from: "a converted textile mill … windows too tall for modern use"
"Fabric scraps pushed against the baseboards when the air system turned on."
"Heat, traffic, hot rubber, river damp, cut weeds, diesel, sunlight."

sound.cue: the soft hinge of the body
sound.from: "I remember striking it with the soft hinge of my body"
sound.note: Not a flutter. A hinge — a dull soft contact, nine per second, felt more than heard.

sound.from: "Not wildly. It moves around the circumference, testing the glass at equal intervals."
sound.note: EIGHT hits per loop, on the same eight stations the scene draws. Must be dead-quantised — an eased tap is the wrong sound and the wrong drawing.

sound.from: "The ventilation system changed pressure. A soft metallic complaint moved through the ductwork."

sound.cue: legs making slow dry sounds too small for the room
sound.from: "its legs making slow, dry sounds too small for the room"

sound.cue: the clicking travelling down the rows
sound.from: "A clicking came from the wall. One chrysalis moved. Then another. The sound travelled down the rows."
sound.note: SEVENTY-FIVE clicks, in date order, oldest first, on the same wavefront the picture sweeps. The sound and the image are one event.

sound.from: "The projector turned on. Its fan rose to speed."
sound.note: AT THE FILM'S OWN FRAME RATE. 12Hz is not an effect over the picture; it is the picture's clock made audible.

sound.from: "Mara smelled water. Not rainwater or drainage. Chlorine, faint but unmistakable."

sound.cue: everything at once, at the break
sound.from: "Heat, traffic, hot rubber, river damp, cut weeds, diesel, sunlight."
sound.note: Enters ON the declared break with no ramp. Before it: interior. After it: seven bands at once.

sound.from: "Inside, fluorescent tubes came on one after another."
